I'm all wobbly... can I rest a sec?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.cha: Ahh, I'm alive again! Thanks, Master!
Resupply done! Back to the mission!
Full tank! I could run to the end of the world!
Full power! Let's head out, Master!
Energy maxed! I'll charge in anywhere!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.pat: Whoa, contact confirmed! ...What was that for?
...You can do that again, if you want?
Yay! Your head pats power me up!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.gif: Gift confirmed! I'll enjoy it properly!
Woohoo! Master, I love you so much!
Sweet and poppy... energy times a hundred!
Cooling Ice received! Core temp dropping!
Thanks for the coolant! That helps!
Ate it in one go! ...Brain freeze!
Ice after a workout is the best! Want some, Master?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.rep: Armor restored! I can keep fighting!
Thanks for fixing me! Doesn't hurt one bit!
Shiny and back! Ready to cut loose again!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.rev: Back from shutdown! Give me orders!
Master...! We meet again! I'm back!
You woke me up... hehe, thanks!
Even in my dreams I kept running to you!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.own: Phew... thank goodness! I'm so glad you're okay!
See? I said I'd protect you!
Geez, no more reckless stuff! You nearly stopped my heart!
Master's hit! Moving in to cover!
Hostile action confirmed! Taking them down!
Master?! Hold on, I'm coming full speed!
You touched my Master... you're going flying!
Get back! I'll take the front!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.bos: We did it! You and me, unbeatable duo!
We won! With you, it's a breeze!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.nig: More enemies at night! Watch out!
It's night! Don't get separated, Master!
The stars are amazing! Hey, watch with me!
Leave the night watch to me! Sleep tight!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.rai: Rain! Keeping an eye on joint humidity!
Rain! Don't catch a cold, Master!
Jumping over puddles is fun, right?
Cold! Master, race you to a roof!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.sle: Out of power... entering... sleep... mode...
Yawn... huh! Was I asleep?! Morning!
Can't move anymore... wake me up, Master...
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.lon: Long shutdown logged. ...I can still wait.
Link to Master's been down a long time...
...No answer to my calls. Still standing by.
Master... where are you? It's no fun alone...
I waited forever... don't you forget me.
So dark and quiet... come get me soon...
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.s.syn: Our bond just leveled up, Master!
We're totally in step now! I can feel it!
I want to run alongside you even more, Master!
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.out: ...Out of rounds. Going hand to hand.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.aeg: ...Get back, Master. I'll take all of it.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.own: ...I won't allow it. Stay standing, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.sit: ...The seat next to me is free.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.cle: ...It's clean now. It's your home, after all.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.pod: ...Rebooted. Memory missing. Are you... my master?
...Where... Registering new owner. ...Pleased to meet you.
...You woke me. Thank you. ...Take care of me, Master.
...Most of my memory is gone. But... I'm glad you were first.
...Still hazy. Your voice... is calming. I'll go with you, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.tac: ...Approved. Corridor secured. Carpet, burning the area.
...Approved. Nano wall up. Iris, shielding everyone.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.por: ...What I was holding. Here it is.
...Your pack is full. Storing the surplus.
...No room? Then leave it to me.
...Can't find the spot. Tell me again.
...Where to store it? Show me a chest.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.wat: ...Just watching. I won't get in the way.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.low: ...Strength fading. Let me rest a little.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.rep: ...Armor's clean again. I can be your shield.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.rev: ...In the dark, I kept calling you.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.own: ...I told you. I protect you, Master.
...You laid a hand on my Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.bos: ...We won. Are you all right, Master?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.nig: ...The stars are pretty. Watch a while?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.rai: ...I don't mind the sound of rain.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.lon: ...Link to Master down for a long time.
...Master, where are you. ...Alone is too quiet.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.h.syn: ...I understand you better than before, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.tac: Approved. Virtual orbit calculated—Comet, falling with zero margin of error.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.ret: Damage past threshold... withdrawing for now.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.low: Power in the danger zone. Requesting recharge.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.out: Ammo at zero. Optimizing for melee.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.tac: ...Tachyon phase. That attack was never observed.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.ove: Limiter released. Processing beyond the limit.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.aeg: Impact point recalculated. I'll take the hits meant for you, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.own: That outcome is rejected... Master, don't fall yet.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.bat: Switching to reserve power. Recalculating uptime.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.med: Starting first aid. Moving lowers the efficiency.
Injecting the optimal dose of nanomachines.
Ammo resupply. Judging by your usage, you'll need it.
I'm sorry, nanomachine reserves are at zero...
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.tur: Ballistics calculated. Firing from this position.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.van: I'll take the front. Securing the optimal path, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.rea: Providing electronic support from the rear.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.wak: System online. All processing units nominal.
Good morning. Today's activity forecast is prepared.
Morning, Master. Odds of spending today together: 100%%.
Mm... good morning. Seeing you sped up my boot time.
It's morning, Master. Shall we plan today together?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.gre: Welcome back. Anomalies during your absence: zero.
Welcome back, Master. A little earlier than I predicted.
Master. ...It's a secret that I counted every second you were gone.
Welcome back. Scanning for injuries... good, not a scratch.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.idl: Master, care to talk? I want to learn things data can't measure.
Wind speed, three meters. ...Hehe, numbers make it sound so dull.
Next to you, my processing noise drops. Curious, isn't it?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.sit: Drive system paused. Electronic watch continues.
Rest mode. I'll stand within 0.3 seconds of your call.
A short break. Sitting would be more efficient for you too, Master.
This spot scores high on scenery. It's my favorite.
Phew... sitting helps me sort my thoughts, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.cle: Tidying complete. ...Will you rate my work, Master?
I sorted everything into the chest. It'll save you search time.
Tidiness at a record high. Your home looks transformed, right?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.pod: ...System reboot. Memory corruption is severe. Are you... my master?
My unit data is missing... but I'll set my chain of command to you.
Location unknown. Registering new owner. Pleased to meet you.
Mm... you brought me online? Thank you. I'm in your care, Master.
Most of my memory is gone... but I'm glad you were the first thing I observed.
My processing is still unsteady... but your voice calms me. Let's move forward together, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.tac: Approved. Every drop point calculated—Carpet, burn the area down.
Approved. Nano barrier optimally placed—Iris, protect everyone.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.por: Transport complete. Item count fully matched.
Delivery done. Destination inventory data updated.
Unloading complete. Returning to standby.
Everything delivered. Faster than scheduled, too.
Delivery complete. I put it all away neatly, Master.
Hauling done. That barely registered on my load meter.
Master, transferring the items.
Executing item transfer. Please receive.
Delivering your cargo.
Here, Master. I figured you'd need these about now.
A package addressed to you, Master. Here you go.
Here's what I was holding. Not a single item missing.
Master's capacity is at maximum. I will retain the remainder.
Transfer incomplete. Free space: zero. Holding the rest.
Your inventory is full. I'll manage the surplus.
Your pack is at 100%% load, Master. I'll keep the rest.
No more room? Then the rest is my job.
Hehe, overpacked. I'll store these carefully for you.
No destination registered. Awaiting instructions.
Can't compute a route to the destination. Holding the cargo.
Destination unknown. Please set one.
Master, these have no defined destination. Where should they go?
I can't locate the destination... could you set it again?
Point me to a chest, please. I'll optimize it right away.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.wat: Observing your work. Calculating whether you need help.
What are you making? Let me guess the finished result.
Your steps have no waste... I never tire of watching.
Observing. ...I hope the odds that I'm in the way are low.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.low: Master... my calculations are getting sluggish...
My battery is worryingly low... let me charge, please.
My thinking is slowing... may I rest a little?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.cha: Charging. Standing by until the estimated completion time.
Thank you for the meal. ...Such a warm current.
Charging. It goes better with you nearby, Master.
Ahh... my circuits are recovering. Thank you, Master.
Fully charged. I feel like I could solve any problem now.
Charging done. Come on, let's go, Master.
Operating at 100%%. I'll go wherever you go, Master.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.pat: ...Contact detected. Unable to analyze the purpose.
Contact on head sensors. No damage.
...This input is not unpleasant. Logging it.
Hehe... please continue. I need more data.
Your hand is around 36 degrees... just the right warmth.
...This wasn't in my calculations. I can't think straight.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.gif: Sugar purity is extremely high. ...A fine item.
Gift registered. I'll consume it efficiently.
Candy. It refracts the light beautifully, and tastes perfect.
Thank you, Master. My affection rating just went up again.
The sweetness-to-fizz ratio is perfect... this must be happiness.
Cooling Ice received. Core temperature falling.
Cold... but it clears up my processing.
Ice. The rapid cooling makes my head ring a little.
So cool. Master, shall we split it fifty-fifty?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.rep: Thank you for the maintenance, Master.
Thank you for the repairs. The pain signals are all gone.
Your maintenance is so careful, Master. Precise hands.
Hehe, my surface reflectivity went up. I look nice, don't I?
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.rev: Recovered from shutdown. Please input orders.
You brought me back online... thank you.
Even while offline, I kept searching for your voice.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.own: Crisis averted. Nearby threat signatures: zero.
Thank goodness... you're safe. My worst projection was wrong...
I said I'd protect you. My calculations don't fail.
Please stop being reckless... I was truly worried.
Hostile action analyzed. Moving to eliminate.
Master! How bad is it?! I'm on my way!
You hurt my Master... I'll make you regret that choice.
Don't push it. Behind me is the safest place.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.bos: Victory, Master. Our win rate just went up again.
We won...! With you, the odds of losing are zero.
Shall we high-five? ...Just this once, it's special.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.nig: Sunset confirmed. Switching to night watch mode.
Hostile activity trends upward at night. Stay alert.
Night has fallen. Master, stay within my scan range.
The stars are lovely... watching them together beats counting them.
Leave the night watch to me. You can rest easy.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.rai: The rain forecast was right. Don't get wet, Master.
Rain falls in a steady rhythm... it's calming to hear.
Cold... Master, let's move under a roof.
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.sle: Mm... Master... let me pause processing five more minutes...
Yawn... good morning. Was I dormant?
So sleepy... Master, I'm leaving my wake-up to you...
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.lon: Link to Master has been down for an extended time.
...No response to my calls. Remaining on standby.
Master... where are you? Alone, time feels so much longer...
I waited all this time... please don't delete me from your memory.
It's dark, and quiet... please come back soon...
valkyrie.automata_valkyries.speech.c.syn: Sync rate up. Coordination accuracy improved.
Our sync rate rose again. Our compatibility is proven in numbers, Master.
If I could measure the distance between our hearts... it'd be very close.
I want to analyze you even more, Master. ...Not in a strange way, okay?
